weakness: Departed and seasonal accounts left active; shared crew and HMI passwords never changed; no account reviews; stale accounts never removed
source: P07 (AC-02 objectives); P03 G-057; P01 R-012
remediation_plan: Departure checklist with same-day removal; season-end and quarterly reviews; remove stale accounts; document account types
milestones: 2026-09-15 stale accounts removed; 2026-10-31 checklist live; 2027-01-15 first quarterly review

weakness: Integrator always-on remote access to the HMI with one shared account, no MFA, no authorization
remediation_plan: Disable always-on access now; jump host with named integrator accounts, MFA, and session approval by the Irrigation Technician
milestones: 2026-09-10 tool set to on-request only; 2026-10-31 jump host live
resources_required: $3,000 MSP labor; jump host $40 per month

weakness: Backups not immutable and in the same account and region; PLC and HMI programs held only by the integrator; no documentation backups
source: P07; P04 finding 2; P01 R-003 and R-015
remediation_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention in a second region; versioned PLC and HMI backups after every change; monthly SYS-01 export
milestones: 2026-10-15 PLC and HMI backups taken and stored offline; 2026-11-30 backup account migrated; 2026-12-31 monthly export running
resources_required: $2,500 per year cloud cost; MSP labor

weakness: No contingency plan; manual irrigation and freeze-protection procedures not written
remediation_plan: Contingency plan from the BIA (P05) with manual pump, pivot, and freeze procedures, paper tally, and hurricane steps
milestones: 2026-11-15 manual irrigation and freeze procedure written and drilled; 2026-12-31 full plan approved

weakness: No restore test or plan exercise ever performed
remediation_plan: Quarterly restore tests (data hub, file share, SYS-01 export, PLC program to spare CPU); annual tabletop; November manual drill
milestones: 2026-10-15 first restore test; 2026-11-15 first manual drill; 2026-11-30 first tabletop

weakness: Flat network: office, packing shed Wi-Fi, and OT share one network; integrator tunnel bypasses boundary
remediation_plan: Separate OT, office, and packing shed networks with firewall rules; OT gateway and site-to-site VPN for data hub traffic
milestones: 2026-10-31 design approved; 2026-12-31 cut-over in the off-hours window

weakness: Antivirus alerts unmonitored; no protection on the HMI; no EDR

milestones: 2026-11-30 contract; 2027-01-31 deployed including HMI
